state: Timeline of an inference optimization effort. Week 1: baseline vLLM serve, p50 latency 210ms, p99 900ms at 40 rps on one L40S. Week 2: enabled continuous batching, p50 dropped to 120ms, p99 to 480ms, GPU util rose from 55% to 88%. Week 3: added prefix caching for the shared 800-token system prompt; cache hit rate stabilized at 72% for the chat workload, p50 further dropped to 85ms. Week 4: speculative decoding with a 0.5B draft model; acceptance rate 61%, p50 now 70ms but p99 regressed to 560ms because the draft-model queue adds tail latency under burst. Week 5 attempt: pinned the draft to the same GPU with a separate CUDA stream; p99 improved to 430ms. Current state: p50 70ms, p99 430ms, GPU util 91%, memory 60/48GB with the draft model resident, occasional OOM during bursts when the KV cache tries to grow. The team must decide whether to keep speculative decoding.
